description: Add a block that shows the newest posts of a blog, podcast or newsletter (any RSS or Atom feed, or a site that links one, like Substack, Ghost or WordPress), or the newest uploads of a YouTube channel (youtube.com/@name) or playlist (youtube.com/playlist?list=…, such as a church's sermons; it must add new videos at the top, or it's refused with how to fix it). Newest first; it updates by itself every hour. count: YouTube 1 (one big player) or 3 (a row); feeds 3 or 5. hideShorts leaves a channel's Shorts out. Change them later with update_block feedCount, hideShorts and rowTitle.

count.description: How many to show. Default: 1 for YouTube, 3 for feeds.

endsAt.description: When it stops showing, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00-08:00. Ask the user's time zone if unsure. null clears it.

hideShorts.description: YouTube channels only: leave out Shorts, so only full videos and past livestreams show.

startsAt.description: When it starts showing, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00-08:00. Ask the user's time zone if unsure. null clears it.

title.description: Shown above it, such as "From the blog".

url.description: The feed, the site, or the YouTube channel or playlist link.

name: add_feed
title: Add a feed or latest YouTube videos
